permitted_analyses.fairness_probe: Group-wise performance at the frozen base-rate threshold
permitted_analyses.learning_curves: Dimension 3 subsample curves scored on the same test partition
permitted_analyses.out_of_time_robustness: Separate temporal experiment on Lending Club
permitted_analyses.paired_bootstrap: Paired stratified bootstrap intervals and pairwise deltas
permitted_analyses.primary_model_comparison: Four-model comparison on the common test partition
permitted_analyses.protected_feature_ablation: Prespecified secondary analysis without protected attributes
permitted_analyses.roi_sensitivity: Economic sensitivity across the prespecified ROI grid

rules: The test partition is read only by analyses listed here.
No test-partition result may change preprocessing, hyperparameters, calibration, thresholds, metric definitions or model inclusion.
Analyses other than the primary comparison are prespecified secondary analyses and are reported as such.
Every access is appended to test_access_log.jsonl.
